name: Math facts (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 43 questions on math as trivia: number words, shapes, measurement, famous numbers (not arithmetic drills - the math game does those) (8 very easy, 10 easy, 11 medium, 14 hard), written by Claude on 2026-10-06; the very easy ones are marked easy with a note "very easy" until the very easy level lands. The independent fact-check kept 43 of 44 written, fixed 12 and deleted 1. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-06, from its own knowledge plus the pages each item cites: no API call. 37 items cite a page the writing pass fetched on 2026-10-06 and quote the phrase on it that supports the fact; 6 rest on "common knowledge" (genuinely universal everyday facts), each with the reason. Then fact-checked item by item by a separate Claude pass on 2026-10-06 that did not write them (every cited page re-fetched and read for the fact, every answer, wrong answer, explanation and level checked; `checked` keeps who checked it and what was fixed; items that could not be made right, and duplicates of other packs, were deleted). Very easy items are marked difficulty "easy" with "note": "very easy" until the very easy level lands. A person still reviews it by playing. On 2026-10-07 every item whose `source` said "common knowledge" was given a real source instead: a page fetched that day that states the fact, with the supporting phrase quoted in `source.note` (each such item's `checked.fixed` records the change).

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.
